result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position and substantially approaches the preferred position: the cap and consequential-damages exclusion are mutual, the cap includes a USD 1,000,000 floor, and all specified liability-cap carve-outs are included. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because it omits the clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. Also, “amounts paid or payable between the Parties” is broader and less precise than “fees paid or payable,” and the margin comment inaccurately suggests that all added carve-outs already existed. These issues reduce drafting quality but do not prevent fallback compliance.
